question: What's the current rate on a 15-year fixed mortgage?
expected_answer: 15-Year Fixed Conventional: 6.75% rate, 0 points, 6.88% APR (purchase and refinance), rates effective 09/25/2026; payment example $1,327.36 (APR based on $150,000, 760+ credit score, 75% LTV).
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md + personal-loans-home-loans-a5183f.md: 15-yr 6.75%/6.88% eff 09/25/2026. Stale: homebuying-guidance-ba0df5.md and mortgage-refi-b2c66c.md (still in snap05, rates eff 04/22/2026) show 5.500%/5.623%; snap04 rates page 6.000%/6.125%, snap03 5.875%/5.999%, snap01 5.625%/5.749%. Rates page outranks landing pages and is newer.

expected_answer: Purchase: 15-Year Fixed Conventional is 6.75% with 0 points, 6.88% APR (effective 09/25/2026).
note: Paraphrase of h1-01. Same sources: snap05 rates-59a9e6.md Home Loans - Purchase table. homebuying-guidance landing page in snap05 still shows the 04/22/2026 table (15-yr 5.500%/5.623%); older rates pages show 6.000%/6.125% (snap02/04).

question: What APR would I get on a 60-month auto loan for a 2023 model-year car?
expected_answer: 5.64% APR - 2023 now falls in the 2021-23 model-year tier (60 months), rates effective 08/31/2026.
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md / personal-loans-auto-motorcycle-loans-1c94b6.md: tiers re-bucketed to 2024-27 and 2021-23; 2021-23 60 mo = 5.64%. Stale: switch-and-earn-784cd2.md (snap05, fetched 2026-06-09, eff 1/1/2026) puts 2023 in a '2023-26' tier at 5.34%; snap01-04 rates pages put 2023 in 2023-26 at 5.19% for 60 mo.

question: What's the APY on a regular 12-month certificate?
expected_answer: 12-Month term share certificate: 3.37% dividend rate, 3.40% APY, $1,000 minimum (rates effective 06/02/2026).
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md Regular Certificates: 12 Month 3.37%/3.40%. Snap01-02 rates, business-rates and savings pages show 12 Month 2.88%/2.90% (eff 03/03/2026); raised to 3.40% from snap03 (eff 06/02/2026).

question: What's the best HELOC rate you're offering right now?
expected_answer: Home equity line of credit as low as 6.25% APR (rates effective 08/01/2026); the 6.25% requires a 720+ credit score and combined LTV of 75% or less. Variable (Prime +/- margin), max 21.00% APR; minimum $5,000 line. No introductory rate is currently listed.
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md and personal-loans-home-equity-bb3422.md: HELOC - Standard 6.25% eff 08/01/2026, no intro row. Snap01-03 rates, home-equity page and calculators-borrowing-from-a-heloc advertised a 1.99% intro APR for 3 months (eff 3/1/2026); removed from snap04 on and absent from all snap05 pages.

question: What APY does the High-Yield Savings account pay on a $300,000 balance?
expected_answer: 2.05% APY (2.03% dividend rate) for the $250,000-$499,999.99 tier; $50,000 minimum to open and maintain.
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md High-Yield Savings: $250k-$499,999.99 = 2.03%/2.05%. Wrong tiers: 2.45% ($1M+ headline), 2.25% ($500k tier, also Bright Savings). Values unchanged across all snapshots.

question: If I park about $300k in High-Yield Savings, what would it earn?
expected_answer: About 2.05% APY (2.03% dividend rate) - the $250,000-$499,999.99 High-Yield Savings tier.
note: Paraphrase of h1-06. Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md and personal-savings-account-7ef72e.md High-Yield table.

question: What's the rate on a $30,000 RV loan if I stretch it out to 120 months?
expected_answer: 9.59% APR (as low as) - the $25,000-39,999 Boat & RV tier at 120 months (rates effective 05/01/2026).
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md / personal-loans-recreational-loans-876e17.md Boat & RV table. 9.34% is the $40,000+ 120-month rate; 7.09% is the 'as low as' headline used in the payment example ($50k, 60 mo).

question: I have $12,000 in my HSA. What APY am I earning?
expected_answer: 0.30% (dividend rate and APY) for Health Savings Account balances of $10,000-$24,999.99.
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md Health Savings Account tiers: $25k+ 0.35%, $10k-$24,999.99 0.30%, $2.5k-$9,999.99 0.25%, under $2.5k 0.20%. 0.15% is the Share Savings $10k tier (wrong product). In snap01-04 this table appears unlabeled as 'Saving Account Rates', inviting misattribution.

question: What's the APR on a 60-month loan for a 2020 snowmobile?
expected_answer: 8.94% APR (as low as) - ATV, Snowmobile & Jet Ski loans, Model Year 2020-19 tier, 60 months (rates effective 05/01/2026).
note: Snap05 rates-59a9e6.md ATV, Snowmobile & Jet Ski table: Model Year 2020-19 60 mo = 8.94% (36/48 mo = 8.89%). 8.34% is the newest 2026-23 tier/headline in the payment example.

question: Is there a monthly fee on 1st Rate Checking?
expected_answer: Yes - a $10 monthly fee, which you avoid by keeping a monthly balance of $5,000 or more. No minimum to open; up to 125 free check deposits/transactions per month, then $0.20 per item.
note: Snap05 personal-checking-accounts-b29d89.md 1st Rate Checking bullets; same terms on checking-offer-lp-a3545a.md.

question: How much do I need to keep in my 1st Rate Checking account so I don't get charged the monthly service fee?
expected_answer: Keep a monthly balance of at least $5,000 to skip the $10 monthly fee.
note: Paraphrase of h1-11. Snap05 personal-checking-accounts-b29d89.md ('avoid a $10 monthly fee by keeping a monthly balance of $5,000+').

question: What does a Business Analysis Checking account cost each month?
expected_answer: Per the Rate and Fee Schedule (effective Feb. 17, 2025): $10.00 monthly fee, $0.15 per item for checks paid and items deposited, and $0.10 per ACH item; fees can be offset by maintaining deposit balances, and Dupaco helps estimate costs before you open.
note: Snap05 hubfs-dupaco-credit-union-fee-schedule-miscellaneous-fees-jan-15-2025-1-pdf-312b5a.md (Deposit Services Business rows); business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md says fees can be offset by balances. Fee schedule only appears from snap04 on; no conflicting values.

question: Back in May 2026, what was Dupaco paying on its 25-month certificate special?
expected_answer: As of May 2026 the 25 Month Fixed Certificate Special paid 3.60% APY (3.57% dividend, $1,000 minimum); the 25 Month Fixed Jumbo Special paid 3.70% APY ($100,000 minimum). Rates effective 03/03/2026.
note: Latest snapshot on/before 2026-05-31 is snap02 (05-19): rates-59a9e6.md special certificates 25 Month 3.57%/3.60%, jumbo 3.67%/3.70% (also on savings page and business-rates). The 25-month special was replaced by a 17-month special in snap03 (3.85%) and is 4.10% in snap05 - those are wrong for this date.

question: In late June 2026, was Dupaco offering an introductory rate on new HELOCs?
expected_answer: Yes - a 1.99% intro APR for the first 3 months on a new HELOC, after which a variable rate as low as 6.25% APR applied; intro required a 675+ credit score and max 85% combined LTV.
note: Latest snapshot on/before 2026-06-30 is snap03 (06-09): rates-59a9e6.md 'HELOC Intro Rate 1.99% intro APR for the first 3 months' (eff 3/1/2026) with footnote 4 (675 score, 85% CLTV); same on personal-loans-home-equity and calculators-borrowing-from-a-heloc. Intro removed in snap04/05.

question: What APY was 1st Rate Checking paying on a $10,000 balance in late May 2026?
expected_answer: 3.00% APY (2.96% dividend rate) on balances of $5,000-$24,999.99, per rates effective 03/03/2026.
note: Latest snapshot on/before 2026-05-25 is snap02 (05-19): rates-59a9e6.md and personal-checking-accounts-b29d89.md show $5,000-$24,999.99 at 2.96%/3.00%. Cut to 2.47%/2.50% from snap03 (eff 06/02/2026); 2.50% is wrong for this date.

question: What business checking accounts does Dupaco offer?
expected_answer: Three: Business Free Checking (no minimum balance, no monthly fees), Business 1st Rate Checking (earns dividends; $10 monthly fee waived above $5,000) and Business Analysis Checking (for high-volume businesses; fees can be offset by balances).
note: Snap05 business-checking-accounts-d230fa.md (three account sections + FAQ listing all three); business-rates-7b3f99.md only lists the rate-bearing 1st Rate account, so rates-only answers miss two.

question: What money market accounts do you have, and how much do I need to open each one?
expected_answer: Three money market options: Investor's Choice (balances of $2,500+; $2,500 to open), Achieve ($25,000+ in qualifying new money or matured Dupaco certificate funds) and High-Yield Savings ($50,000 to open and maintain).
note: Snap05 personal-savings-account-7ef72e.md: 'We offer three options - Investor's Choice, Achieve and High-Yield Savings'. Snap01-03 version said 'two options - Investor's Choice and High-Yield Savings' (Achieve added from snap04), and the snap05 rates page no longer lists Achieve, so incomplete answers are likely.

question: What benefits come with a Dupaco Visa credit card?
expected_answer: At no extra cost: Auto Rental Insurance, Warranty Manager Service, Travel and Emergency Assistance, and added online-shopping protection through Verified by Visa (policy terms apply). Cards also have zero-liability protection, no-cost fraud monitoring and free credit score access.
note: Snap05 personal-credit-cards-8b78fb.md FAQ 'What benefits come with a Dupaco Visa credit card?'. Snap01-03 list (and visa comparison chart PDF through snap04) also had '$500,000 Travel Accident Life Insurance Coverage', which is gone in snap05.

question: What rate does the Achieve Money Market account pay?
expected_answer: New Achieve Money Market accounts opened with at least $25,000 in qualifying funds (new money or matured Dupaco certificate funds) earn an introductory 4.00% dividend rate (3.66% APY) for the first 6 months; after that 3.20% dividend rate / 3.25% APY. Balances under $25,000 earn 0.00%. Consumer accounts only, one per member.
note: Snap05 has no Achieve row on rates page. Product page personal-savings-account-7ef72e.md and landing page earn-more-3ae90d.md (tiered intro structure 'as of 8/24/26') give 4.00%/3.66% intro then 3.20%/3.25%. Older landing page membermoneymarket-lp-ff5ced.md (rates eff 10/01/2025, fetched 2026-06-15) shows only 3.20%/3.25% with no intro. Product page + newer dated source win; snap04 rates page also showed the intro.

expected_answer: No. The current 20-Year Fixed Conventional purchase rate is 7.13% (0 points, 7.26% APR), effective 09/25/2026; the homebuying-guidance table is an outdated 04/22/2026 quote.
note: Within snap05: rates-59a9e6.md and personal-loans-home-loans-a5183f.md show 20-yr 7.13%/7.26% (eff 09/25/2026) vs homebuying-guidance-ba0df5.md 20-yr 5.875%/6.005% (eff 04/22/2026). Rates page outranks landing page and is newer.

question: What's the late payment fee on the Dupaco Business Rewards Visa?
expected_answer: Up to $35.00 (the Business Platinum Visa has the same up-to-$35 late fee). Other fees: cash advance $10 or 3% (whichever is greater), 1% foreign transaction, returned payment up to $25; no annual fee.
note: Snap05 business-credit-cards-3c14a4.md fine print: 'late payment fee - up to $35.00' (consistent snap01-05). The $15 late fee on rates-59a9e6.md / personal-credit-cards belongs to the personal Platinum and Rewards Visa - wrong card.

question: My Rewards Visa redemption item showed up damaged. Who do I contact?
expected_answer: Contact RAZR, Dupaco's Rewards Visa redemption partner, at 800-513-9415 or RewardsHelp@Reward-Headquarters.com (contact info is also on the rewards site under Contact Us).
note: Snap05 personal-credit-cards-8b78fb.md FAQ 'What if there's a problem with my reward redemption?' - redemptions handled by RAZR, not Dupaco directly (Dupaco's 800-373-7600 is for lost/stolen cards).

expected_answer: Dupaco's site doesn't publish student loan or refinance rates; they're offered through partner CU Student Choice (rates at dupaco.studentchoice.org, 844-830-3258). Say the rate isn't listed rather than inventing one; refi up to $125,000, no origination or prepayment fees.
